item.title: Fnatic confirms Razork exit as Lospa’s SK Gaming move deepens 2027 rebuild
item.description:
Fnatic has confirmed the departure of its longest-serving player, jungler Razork, who is set to join Team Heretics. With support Lospa also set to leave, the London club faces a near-total LEC roster rebuild for 2027.

item.title: Caedrel and Dan Gaskin win for Britain at Esports Awards as Counter-Strike 2 takes top game
item.description:
Britain's Marc 'Caedrel' Lamont and Dan Gaskin were among the winners at the 2026 Esports Awards in Miami, where Counter-Strike 2 was named game of the year and Team Vitality and BLAST also took industry honours. The results crown a strong Counter-Strike year eight days before the next CS2 Major begins in Singapore.

The post Caedrel and Dan Gaskin win for Britain at Esports Awards as Counter-Strike 2 takes top game appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: Sentinels complete 2027 VALORANT roster with British player keiko, reuniting him with brawk
item.description:
Sentinels have signed Briton Georgio 'keiko' Sanassy from NRG as the final starter in their 2027 VCT Americas lineup. The move pairs him again with former NRG teammate brawk as Sentinels try to return to international events after missing them all in 2026.

The post Sentinels complete 2027 VALORANT roster with British player keiko, reuniting him with brawk appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: Bilibili Gaming beat all four LCK teams to win Worlds 2026 and end Korean title run
item.description:
Bilibili Gaming beat Gen.G in Brooklyn to win the 2026 League of Legends World Championship, the LPL's first world title since 2021. Added to their First Stand trophy, the result gives a Chinese side a double that no team had managed since 2016, just as Riot takes the 2027 season opener to China.

The post Bilibili Gaming beat all four LCK teams to win Worlds 2026 and end Korean title run appeared first on Esports Insider.
